baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1-2 couple the garden noun with an adjective of thick, interlaced fullness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun supplies a bounded orchard while the adjective supplies dense internal growth, so enclosure concentrates abundance rather than merely naming generic greenery.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed-orchard branch supplies the bounded cultivated unit named by word 1.
The thick, interlaced-fullness branch gives word 2 its direct vegetative density and explains what fills the enclosure.

changed_reading.before: A list item meaning luxuriant gardens.
changed_reading.after: Bounded orchard chambers whose defining feature is concentrated, interwoven fullness within a perimeter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two words can join encirclement to the root's more forceful sense of prevailing.
baseline_models.mechanism: An encircling boundary and an overpowering force create a live tension: the growth does not only occupy its garden but presses through, fills, and nearly masters its container.

activation_trace.role: The encircling branch establishes a perimeter around a center and therefore a possible surface against which fullness presses.
The overpowering-force branch recasts the adjective as active prevalence rather than only visual thickness.
The direct dense-fullness branch keeps the force reading materially anchored in tangled vegetation.

changed_reading.after: Dense growth is caught at the point where it fills and overmasters the space meant to contain it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The garden root also carries pupil and fixed-looking branches, while word 2 makes the field crowded and intense.
baseline_models.mechanism: Without replacing the literal orchards, the line can leave an ocular afterimage: dark centers, circular enclosures, and a scene dense enough to arrest the gaze.

activation_trace.role: The pupil branch supplies a dark centered visual form latent inside the garden root.
The fixed-looking branch turns the orchard from scenery into a possible focal demand.
Dense fullness gives the ocular image multiplicity and visual insistence while preserving vegetation.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are only an object in a produce catalogue.
changed_reading.after: They remain literal gardens but also form a dense visual field that solicits sustained looking.

context_deltas.mechanism: Poured water is delivered, closed earth is opened, and plants emerge; at the focus, the force and density of غلب become the accumulated result of vegetation prevailing through resistance and then crowding bounded plots.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed orchard is the bounded destination in which the prior operations become visible.
Overpowering force supplies the active sense that growth has prevailed over resistance.
Thick interlacing supplies the final material state produced by that prevalence.
The pouring branch supplies the directed liquid input that starts the production chain.
The irrigation-and-delivery branch makes water an applied growth-enabling medium rather than background scenery.
The splitting-open branch supplies the breached resistance through which growth can pass.
The plant-emerging-from-earth branch supplies the upward response that culminates in dense gardens.

structural_cues: Ayat 80:25-27 order poured water, deliberately split earth, and caused emergence before the species list reaches 80:30.
The cognate accusatives intensify pouring and splitting, while 80:30 has no new verb and can therefore register the visible result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, fissure, emergence, overpowering force, and final density; I supply the arrow that plants prevail against closed soil and then their enclosure. A live alternative is a simple creation sequence in which غلبا remains purely descriptive.

changed_reading.after: Their density is an event's residue: watered growth has broken through resistance, prevailed, and massed inside bounded ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sits inside a food chain that ends in both fruit and pasture and then names human and livestock beneficiaries. Its dense enclosure therefore functions as productive habitat and distribution infrastructure, not an ornamental garden isolated from use.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed-orchard branch supplies a managed ecological unit capable of holding several outputs together.
Dense fullness makes the unit high-capacity rather than decorative or sparse.
The livelihood-and-sustenance branch frames the entire inspected sequence as maintenance of life.
The pleasant-fruit branch supplies one output of the dense garden for human enjoyment.
The pasture branch supplies a second output extending the enclosure's productivity beyond human fruit.
The enjoyed-and-useful benefit branch turns the catalogue into provision received by beneficiaries.
The livestock branch identifies a nonhuman beneficiary and broadens the garden into a shared provisioning habitat.

structural_cues: Ayah 80:30 falls between the crop catalogue of 80:27-29 and the paired outputs fruit and pasture in 80:31.
The beneficiary clause in 80:32 explicitly separates you from your livestock while including both.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, density, food, two output classes, benefit, and two beneficiary classes; I infer that the garden is the mediating habitat that organizes them. The live alternative is that each noun is only a coordinate list item with no infrastructural hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: An impressive orchard appears among other crops.
changed_reading.after: A densely productive enclosure mediates water and soil into differentiated sustenance shared across human and animal life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early seeker may grow or purify through a beneficial reminder; the later earth receives an input, sprouts, and culminates in dense enclosed growth. The focus can thus materialize receptivity: abundance follows response and cultivation, not presumed self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: The cultivated enclosure supplies a bounded site in which receptive growth can be tended and recognized.
Dense increase supplies the mature outcome of receptivity rather than a merely initial sprout.
The growth-and-increase branch makes the seeker's possible purification also legible as development.
The reminder branch supplies the received stimulus in the human growth sequence.
The benefit branch supplies the positive effect that links reception to transformation.
The planting-and-cultivation branch gives the later material sequence an active developmental mechanism.

structural_cues: Ayat 80:3-4 couple hoped-for growth or purification with a reminder that may benefit, and 80:7 repeats the growth term negatively.
Ayat 80:25-30 later supply a material reception-to-growth sequence without stating an explicit simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two chains, reminder-to-beneficial growth and water-to-cultivated density; I supply the analogy that the second makes the first materially visible. They may instead be independent demonstrations, so the ethical cultivation reading coexists with the agricultural one.

changed_reading.before: The gardens show only botanical fertility.
changed_reading.after: Their bounded density becomes a material analogue for a person who receives a reminder and grows, sharpening the earlier ethics of receptivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pupil and fixed-looking branches of the garden root become active across an attention arc: physical blindness is foregrounded early, then the human is commanded to direct sight or insight toward food, and the gardens arrive inside what must be examined.

activation_trace.role: The pupil branch supplies the focus word's latent ocular center.
The fixed-looking branch makes the garden sequence a sustained demand on attention.
Dense fullness supplies the visually arresting object without displacing the literal vegetation.
The loss-of-sight branch foregrounds physical blindness and destabilizes any easy equation of vision with perception.
The directing-sight-or-insight branch supplies the explicit act through which the food sequence, including the focus, is to be apprehended.
The eye-and-place-of-looking branch tightens the packet's lexical contact with the pupil branch in the focus root.

structural_cues: Ayah 80:2 foregrounds absent physical sight, while 80:24 later issues an imperative to look before narrating production.
Ayah 80:30 stands near the culmination of the object placed under that imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blindness, directed sight or insight, eye, pupil, and fixed gaze; I infer an ethical attention arc in which the garden is something to perceive rightly. This does not make حدائق mean eyes, and the ordinary reading as literal gardens remains primary.

changed_reading.before: The abundance is passively visible scenery.
changed_reading.after: The dense gardens become part of an instructed act of attention, asking whether sight reaches the provisioning process and its claims rather than merely registering produce.

context_deltas.mechanism: Burial hides a body, resurrection revives and unfolds it, then earth is split and plants emerge into dense enclosed gardens. The focus is the maximal visible endpoint of an emergence-from-confinement pattern, with the resurrection root itself carrying rain-revived pasture as a bridge.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed garden supplies a final bounded form reached after emergence from another enclosure.
Dense fullness supplies the abundant endpoint that exceeds the smallness and hiddenness of origins.
The burial branch supplies bodily concealment within earth as the first side of the pattern.
The reviving-the-dead branch supplies the human emergence that the botanical sequence can echo.
The rain-revived dry-pasture branch directly bridges resurrection vocabulary to the later watered vegetation.
The opening fissure supplies the route from hidden interior to exposed life.
The plant emerging from earth supplies the observable analogue that reaches full density at the focus.

structural_cues: Ayat 80:21-22 place burial and revivification immediately before the command to inspect food and the earth-growth sequence.
The sequence contracts a human life cycle and then expands a botanical one, both moving through hiddenness toward emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burial, reviving, a branch explicitly linking revival to rain-restored pasture, earth opening, plant emergence, and dense gardens; I infer that the focus completes a material rehearsal of resurrection. A live alternative is juxtaposed demonstrations of power with no one-to-one analogy.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are the endpoint of an agricultural explanation.
changed_reading.after: They also become an ecological diagram of life emerging from earthen confinement, carrying the preceding burial-and-revival sequence into visible fullness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: It is surprising to let literal gardens resemble a field of pupils or a gaze returned by creation, but the pupil, fixed-looking, eye, and later face branches keep the image anchored. Downstream prose should present this only as an ocular afterimage activated by the root network, never as a translation of حدائق or a claim that the orchards literally see.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 activates both pupil and fixed stare, and word 2 crowds that visual image without cancelling the ordinary orchard.

activation_trace.role: The pupil branch gives each enclosed garden a possible eye-like center in the exploratory image.
The fixed-stare branch turns eye-like form into the possibility of reciprocal looking.
Dense interlacing multiplies and intensifies the visual field while retaining botanical substance.
The eye as the place of looking supplies the context trigger for hearing the pupil branch in the focus.
The later face-and-front branch extends the surah's concern with exposed surfaces that meet an observer.

changed_reading.before: The observer looks at a dense garden from outside.
changed_reading.after: As contained wordplay, the dense gardens can seem to look back, making observation reciprocal and the observer answerable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The contrast between ecological enclosure and later social flight crosses domains and is not stated as an allegory. It remains anchored in the focus root's encircling garden and in explicit branches of flight, bond, and companionship; render it as a structural counterimage, not as the lexical meaning of the focus ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The garden is a densely held-together enclosure; later context depicts people leaving their closest circles.

activation_trace.role: The encircling branch supplies the coherent surrounding relation used in the contrast.
The enclosed-orchard branch grounds that surrounding relation in the literal focus image.
Dense interlacing supplies internal cohesion on the ecological side of the contrast.
The flight branch supplies the later motion out of relational proximity.
The bond branch makes the brother relation a tie whose failure can be contrasted with enclosure.
The companionship-and-adherence branch supplies another close relation that no longer holds people together.

changed_reading.before: The garden wall and density are only agronomic properties.
changed_reading.after: The coherent ecological enclosure becomes a fragile counterimage to the later unraveling of human circles under overwhelming pressure.

strongest_changes: The causative water-earth-growth sequence turns غلب from static thickness into vegetation's successful breakthrough and prevalence.
The food, fruit, pasture, benefit, and livestock cues turn the enclosed garden into shared provisioning habitat.
The resurrection root's rain-revived-pasture branch joins burial and revival to the later split-earth emergence sequence.
Blindness, commanded looking, pupil, and fixed gaze activate an ethics of attention around the literal gardens.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots remain multiply active: enclosure, pupil, fixed gaze, dense interlacing, and overpowering force support hydraulic, provisioning, ethical-growth, resurrection, and ocular readings without requiring one final disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: The overpowering-force branch may be less morphologically immediate in غلبا than the directly attested dense-garden branch, even though the process sequence strongly activates it.
The ocular reading may be only a latent root echo rather than an audible feature of ordinary usage.
The ethical-cultivation and resurrection models depend on reader-supplied analogical arrows, though the packet provides unusually specific bridge branches.
The enclosure-versus-flight outlier is a cross-domain structural contrast and should remain explicitly exploratory.
